issues.what: Across the hook the shot never changes idea. The arch only brightens and thickens (upper-center luminance about +40; hot pixels from 9% to 13%). Same frame, no cut, no scale change, no new subject. At phone width the nine frames read as one still, so staying is not rewarded.
issues.fix: Make the last hook frame a different event than the first: push in, let the loop break or leave frame, or bring in a second subject before the hook ends.

issues.what: The first frame is a locked wide beauty shot. The sun, dark sunspot, and plasma arch are readable at this size, but nothing is already moving and nothing poses a question, so with the sound off it scrolls past like a still.
issues.fix: Open mid-motion, with the arch already whipping or the camera already pushing, so frame 0 is an event at phone width.

issues.what: About 28% of the first frame is near-black sky, so the hero arch does not fill the phone-width frame until a later glow.
issues.fix: Crop tighter on the arch and sunspot so the bright shape owns the width in the first frame.
